title: Preserve settings on a transient rename staging read failure

scope_proof.exact_raw_application_change: Only renameStudent staging reader call replaced; reconstructing the prior file with this single literal replacement equals the complete current raw file.

change.before: getRawSettings catches a one-time storage error and supplies an empty object. A subsequent successful transaction prefers that truthy supplied object, retaining only the stored API-key rule and dropping unrelated settings/identity metadata.
change.after: readWftRequiredStorage('wft_settings') validates the staging snapshot and propagates a failed read into the existing rename catch before persistence or UI publication. Successful reads pass the same settings to the existing identity updater and atomic save.
change.preserved: Broad read-only getRawSettings, confirmations/cancellation, roster revalidation, exact portfolio/media bytes, current writing/pending work, ID-map default false, legacy IDs, marker ordering, strict transaction/rollback and credential rules remain unchanged.

caller_order_evidence.role: Production manager chooses a current student then awaits renameStudent.
Real input/confirmation dialogs yield; current roster and strict portfolio are rechecked; staged settings read is inside existing failure-reporting try before identity update and save.
Existing identity update only runs when supported ID-map flag is enabled and uses supplied settings.
Existing multi-key save validates required state, uses supplied settings, preserves API-key rule, rolls back failed writes and publishes only after commit.
Existing required reader propagates native read/parse/schema failures rather than constructing a successful empty snapshot.

native_regression.failure: One wft_settings read throws after the actual confirmation; later reads succeed. Both shipped false and supported true ID-map states are tested.
native_regression.seed: Two stable student records, unknown nested preferences, nondefault word target, two portfolios with photo identity, exact tab-only writing and in-memory pending session/photo data.
native_regression.failed_rename_assertions: Exact five storage-key bytes, roster, selected/UI student, sync counters/pending flags, writing and pending-work JSON remain unchanged; no false success and teacher receives existing failure notice.
native_regression.retry_assertions: Same native dialog flow succeeds once storage is readable; unknown preferences, both stable records and default/compatibility identity semantics remain intact, with unchanged writing/pending work and preserved portfolio photo identities.

remaining_expectations: The source lead is behaviorally repaired. Existing rename complexity and optional renderer catches are not claimed cleared; their local metric facts remain unchanged.
Coordinator must independently accept/commit, refresh RepoWise and run the publication batch gate. No index write was performed by this repair.
limits: No full75-suite run, live Google/Drive/model calls, real accounts or student data.
Native tests reproduce one synchronous staging read failure and normal retry. This does not add cross-tab locking or change transaction/crash recovery architecture.
No Git mutations, tracker/docs/index edits, other chats/subagents or external messages. Source remains uncommitted for coordinator review.
